title: AuthorRecordDecisionParams
description:
`author.record_decision` records a baseline ratified (supporting) decision
on the workspace's branch.

A fact citing this decision can read `certain` and participate in canon
checks. The caller supplies the exact decision id; recording it again is
idempotent. A later `author.defeat` can defeat it. The engine records the
ruling but does not decide who is allowed to make one.

decision.description: The decision id to record (caller-supplied, exact-equality matched).

provenance.description:
Optional provenance for a decision that itself rests on prior decisions:
its cited ids are integrity-gated (an unresolved citation raises
`citation.unknown-decision` and bars the record), exactly as a fact's
citation is.

rationale.description:
Optional human rationale for the ruling — recorded as review metadata,
scanned for control characters, never interpreted.

workspace.description: The authoring workspace whose branch records the decision.

Provenance.description:
Provenance supplied when adding authored material. Internally tagged on
`kind`; origin tracking is load-bearing for the authoring seam (nothing an agent supplies
mints authority).

oneOf.description: Cited to one or more decisions: `{"kind":"cited","decisions":["D-0104"]}`.

decisions.description: The cited decision identifiers in the consuming repo's ledger.

state.description: The requested standing for the cited claim.

origin.description: The origin token of the proposal (e.g. an agent session id).

hyp.description: The hypothesis the material is conditioned on.

ProvenanceState.description:
The stored standing requested for a cited authoring operation.

Cited provenance requires this field at the request boundary.
